subject.title: Add a shared Plugin SDK HTML escaping utility

question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime` permanently expose `escapeHtml`, or should HTML escaping remain owned by individual plugins or a non-public internal utility?
rationale: The consolidation is technically narrow, but adding a callable Plugin SDK export establishes a public compatibility contract that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK helper
options.body: Add the dependency-free five-entity helper to the existing text utility entrypoint and migrate all six consumers in one focused change.

options.title: Keep plugin-local ownership
options.body: Reject the new public SDK surface and instead align the local helpers without creating a permanent plugin API contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK helper
recommendation.body: Add the dependency-free five-entity helper to the existing text utility entrypoint and migrate all six consumers in one focused change.
